visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An orange and white tabby cat lies curled up inside a brown cardboard box on a wooden floor. The cat has wide, amber eyes and white fur around its snout, chest, and paws. A soft purple blanket is tucked beneath its front legs. The cat stares intently at the camera while keeping its body tucked. (2) The camera zooms in closer on the cat's face. The cat blinks and begins to knead the purple blanket with its front paws, rhythmically pushing and pulling its claws. Yellow and white Traditional Chinese subtitles and decorative variety captions appear at the top and bottom of the frame. (3) The cat continues to knead the blanket while looking around the room, occasionally glancing back at the camera. Its ears twitch as if listening to background conversation. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the texture of the cat's fur and the cardboard edges. (4) A hand with light skin and a gold bracelet reaches into the box from the left, gently stroking the cat's head. The cat squints its eyes in relaxation. Later, the hand touches the cat's belly, and a red anger-vein emoji is edited onto the cat's chest, followed by the cat looking slightly startled.
